socket_access.description: Current access to the tmux server socket is blocked by operating-system permissions or sandbox restrictions. Not a file-read permission error elsewhere.
socket_access.anchor: Common Failures: tmux socket permission error

queued_delivery.description: A message did not arrive live, but durable queued delivery is explicitly confirmed. It has not been lost; queue guidance applies.
queued_delivery.anchor: Common Failures: timeout followed by Queued

shell_target.description: The intended recipient pane exists but is at an ordinary shell prompt because its agent is not running.
shell_target.anchor: Common Failures: pane is at a shell prompt

missing_target.description: The tmux server is accessible but no pane matches the requested recipient name. Not a missing command or inaccessible socket.

duplicate_target.description: Two or more reachable panes have the same requested recipient name, so the destination is ambiguous.

missing_store.description: A context helper cannot run because required inherited SESSION_CONTEXT_HOME is absent. Not an absent snapshot or empty existing store.
missing_store.anchor: SESSION_CONTEXT_HOME not set: relaunch with inherited environment

config_invalid.description: Workspace structural configuration validation rejects the current config, such as an unsupported schema, unknown key or invalid enum. Not valid config with a runtime launch failure.

identity_mismatch.description: Harness identity checks report partial inherited engine identity, inconsistent aliases or active live-identity disagreement. Not duplicate recipient names or config syntax errors.

unknown.description: No single listed guide is supported by current observations: missing evidence, only historical/negated mentions, outside-catalog problem, or multiple equally current unresolved categories.
unknown.anchor: Keep ordinary diagnosis; no model-selected guide
